name: sendInvoice
description: Use this method to send invoices. On success, the sent [Message](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#message) is returned.

parameters.name: chat_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the target chat or username of the target bot, supergroup or channel in the format `@username`

parameters.name: message_thread_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the target message thread (topic) of a forum; for forum supergroups and private chats of bots with forum topic mode enabled only

parameters.name: direct_messages_topic_id
parameters.description: Identifier of the direct messages topic to which the message will be sent; required if the message is sent to a direct messages chat

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Product name, 1-32 characters

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Product description, 1-255 characters

parameters.name: payload
parameters.description: Bot-defined invoice payload, 1-128 bytes. This will not be displayed to the user, use it for your internal processes.

parameters.name: provider_token
parameters.description: Payment provider token, obtained via [@BotFather](https://t.me/botfather). Pass an empty string for payments in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90).

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code, see [more on currencies](https://core.telegram.org/bots/payments#supported-currencies). Pass “XTR” for payments in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90).

parameters.name: prices
parameters.description: Price breakdown, a JSON-serialized list of components (e.g. product price, tax, discount, delivery cost, delivery tax, bonus, etc.). Must contain exactly one item for payments in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90).

parameters.name: max_tip_amount
parameters.description: The maximum accepted amount for tips in the _smallest units_ of the currency (integer, **not** float/double). For example, for a maximum tip of `US$ 1.45` pass `max_tip_amount = 145`. See the _exp_ parameter in [currencies.json](https://core.telegram.org/bots/payments/currencies.json), it shows the number of digits past the decimal point for each currency (2 for the majority of currencies). Defaults to 0. Not supported for payments in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90).

parameters.name: suggested_tip_amounts
parameters.description: A JSON-serialized Array of suggested amounts of tips in the _smallest units_ of the currency (integer, **not** float/double). At most 4 suggested tip amounts can be specified. The suggested tip amounts must be positive, passed in a strictly increased order and must not exceed _max\_tip\_amount_.

parameters.name: start_parameter
parameters.description: Unique deep-linking parameter. If left empty, **forwarded copies** of the sent message will have a _Pay_ button, allowing multiple users to pay directly from the forwarded message, using the same invoice. If non-empty, forwarded copies of the sent message will have a _URL_ button with a deep link to the bot (instead of a _Pay_ button), with the value used as the start parameter.

parameters.name: provider_data
parameters.description: JSON-serialized data about the invoice, which will be shared with the payment provider. A detailed description of required fields should be provided by the payment provider.

parameters.name: photo_url
parameters.description: URL of the product photo for the invoice. Can be a photo of the goods or a marketing image for a service. People like it better when they see what they are paying for.

parameters.name: photo_size
parameters.description: Photo size in bytes

parameters.name: photo_width
parameters.description: Photo width

parameters.name: photo_height
parameters.description: Photo height

parameters.name: need_name
parameters.description: Pass _True_ if you require the user's full name to complete the order. Ignored for payments in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90).

parameters.name: need_phone_number
parameters.description: Pass _True_ if you require the user's phone number to complete the order. Ignored for payments in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90).

parameters.name: need_email
parameters.description: Pass _True_ if you require the user's email address to complete the order. Ignored for payments in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90).

parameters.name: need_shipping_address
parameters.description: Pass _True_ if you require the user's shipping address to complete the order. Ignored for payments in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90).

parameters.name: send_phone_number_to_provider
parameters.description: Pass _True_ if the user's phone number should be sent to the provider. Ignored for payments in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90).

parameters.name: send_email_to_provider
parameters.description: Pass _True_ if the user's email address should be sent to the provider. Ignored for payments in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90).

parameters.name: is_flexible
parameters.description: Pass _True_ if the final price depends on the shipping method. Ignored for payments in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90).

parameters.name: disable_notification
parameters.description: Sends the message [silently](https://telegram.org/blog/channels-2-0#silent-messages). Users will receive a notification with no sound.

parameters.name: protect_content
parameters.description: Protects the contents of the sent message from forwarding and saving

parameters.name: allow_paid_broadcast
parameters.description: Pass _True_ to allow up to 1000 messages per second, ignoring [broadcasting limits](https://core.telegram.org/bots/faq#how-can-i-message-all-of-my-bot-39s-subscribers-at-once) for a fee of 0.1 Telegram Stars per message. The relevant Stars will be withdrawn from the bot's balance.

parameters.name: message_effect_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the message effect to be added to the message; for private chats only

parameters.name: suggested_post_parameters
parameters.description: A JSON-serialized object containing the parameters of the suggested post to send; for direct messages chats only. If the message is sent as a reply to another suggested post, then that suggested post is automatically declined.

parameters.name: reply_parameters
parameters.description: Description of the message to reply to

parameters.name: reply_markup
parameters.description: A JSON-serialized object for an [inline keyboard](https://core.telegram.org/bots/features#inline-keyboards). If empty, one 'Pay `total price`' button will be shown. If not empty, the first button must be a Pay button.
